scope: Full 1502-frame hard set: SuperPoint+LightGlue candidates replacing the DINOv2 patch matcher, then the same GT-free independent LiDAR geometric verification, then GT-offline comparison of the tiered rule and the fallback-relative rule
cohort: frozen historical V7 epoch10 T>0.5m 1502 frames

matcher.image_pipeline: identical to the frozen four-frame run: RGB, ROTATE_270, longest edge <=560 bicubic, centre crop to multiple of 14
matcher.association: nearest LiDAR return in model-pixel space, keep if distance <= 3.5 px
matcher.dedup: one correspondence per query keypoint, highest LightGlue score wins

rules.tiered: candidate must pass geometry_verified AND be directionally observable, else keep the frozen V7 baseline output
rules.relative_v7: per frame take the highest-scoring candidate; accept it iff its GT-free score exceeds the score of that frame's frozen V7 output; else keep the V7 output
rules.relative_v7_margin_0.1: same as relative_v7 but the candidate must exceed the V7 score by at least 0.1
rules.relative_sc2: same but compared against the raw SC2 initial, which is the weaker bar and is reported only for continuity with the four-frame study
rules.note: the pipeline's real fallback is SC2 followed by V7 refinement, so the frozen V7 output is the pose a rule has to beat
